strategy_version: V1 / DD Only / Combined DD+Vol (path-robustness stress)
dataset: exp_007 net returns; SPY & NIFTY50 market series; P02 vol-regime
assumptions: Monte Carlo used for path robustness/stress, NOT significance. Gaussian baseline; dependence-preserving block bootstrap; per-market GARCH-t; 2-state regime stress. Cross-market/regime rows preserve the strategy edge and transplant the risk environment (not a strategy replay).
hypothesis: Descriptive robustness — no null hypothesis is tested here.
limitations: Japan/Brazil have no return series (excluded, not approximated); strategies cannot be replayed cross-market (US-only signals); GARCH(1,1) only partially reproduces the most extreme drawdowns/kurtosis; regime stress uses a 2-state (not 5-state) taxonomy.

extra.note: path robustness / stress framework; no winner selected
